page.overview:
Who is Andros?

Andros was an olive-skinned Tilean duellist and advisor to Grand Elector Count of Ostermark Otto von Gruber in the immediate aftermath of the Great War Against Chaos.

He was slain by an arrow while escorting von Gruber.
